note: The shared-cell live variant of the authenticates_vault_role expected set. The per-Odù file (ifa-authenticates-vault-role-family-expected-edges.json) names the two edges the authenticates fixture scope produces; a shared determinism cell graph ALSO holds the uses fixture scope, whose two exact chains take the same Vault hop and therefore materialize two more SECRETS_IAM_AUTHENTICATES_TO_VAULT_ROLE edges (sa-uses-app-a through role uses-app-a to Vault role uses-vault-role-1, and sa-uses-app-b through role uses-app-b to uses-vault-role-2), AND the grants fixture scope, whose four exact chains (lanes A, B, 7, 8) take the same Vault hop and therefore materialize four more edges (sa-grants-app-a through role grants-app-a to grants-vault-role-1, sa-grants-app-b through role grants-app-b to grants-vault-role-2, sa-grants-app-7 through role grants-app-7 to grants-vault-role-3, and sa-grants-app-8 through role grants-app-8 to grants-vault-role-4), AND the assumes fixture scope, whose two exact chains take the same Vault hop and therefore materialize three more edges (sa-assumes-app-a through role assumes-app-a to Vault roles assumes-vault-role-1 and assumes-vault-role-2 -- lane A binds two roles, proving duplicate delivery converges -- and sa-assumes-app-b through role assumes-app-b to assumes-vault-role-3), AND the uses-service-account fixture scope, whose two exact chains take the same Vault hop and therefore materialize two more edges (the orders workload through its IRSA web-identity service account to uses-vault-role-orders, and the billing workload through its EKS Pod Identity service account to uses-vault-role-billing; the stale and orphan lanes have no exact identity chain with a workload id and stay edge-free). The projection handler writes every edge set its read models resolve in one run, so the type's exact live set is thirteen edges, not two. Fresh-stack fault cells drive one vault cassette and keep asserting the two-edge file; only the shared-cell determinism assert uses this file.
